summary.text: Tracy Cramer is the Republican candidate for the Oregon State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Virginia Stapleton (D/Working Families Party). She served in the Oregon House of Representatives, District 22, from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Cramer was born in Gervais, Oregon, and received a degree from Anthem College in 2011.
She represented House District 22 from 2023 to 2025, succeeding Teresa Alonso Leon (D); Lesly Muñoz (D) succeeded her.
During the 2023-2024 term she was assigned to the Early Childhood Committee and the House Education Committee.
Cramer advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 11 on May 19, 2026.
